reason: Section 15.8 separates the scope and Director discretion for the post-2025 general assessment rule from the calculation minimum and transfer rule.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Real property covered or excluded from section 15.8
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections define current year, state the years and real property covered, list exceptions, and give final Director discretion.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall what real property section 15.8 covers or excludes and the finality of the Director inclusion or exclusion decision.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Section 15.8 assessment amount and transfer rule
proposedGroups.reason: The last three subsections set the minimum, lesser-of calculation, and transferred-property rule.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how section 15.8 determines the assessment amount and how transferred property is treated.

reason: Section 16 covers separate farm use assessment, timberland or woodlot classification, evidentiary effect, and Court appeal rules.

proposedGroups.reason: The first three subsections set the Director determination and classification rules for farmland, freehold timberland, and farm woodlots.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when real property is assessed as farmland, freehold timberland, or farm woodlots and what the Director determines.

proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 16(4) gives evidentiary effect to the Director determination or classification.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the evidentiary effect of the Director farmland and timberland determinations.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Court appeal for timberland or woodlot classification
proposedGroups.reason: The final subsections create a specific Court appeal route and state its deadline and possible order.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when and how a person may appeal for freehold timberland or farm woodlot classification.

reason: Section 17 is one valuation topic for real property classified as freehold timberland or farm woodlots, including per-hectare values and block or size classification rules.

reason: Section 17.1 is one assessment regime for real property in actual and bona fide use as a golf course, including Director determination, appeal, deadline, and evidentiary effect.

Section 21 contains distinct rules for annual assessment notices, mailing or electronic delivery, requested copies, and the legal effect of notice errors or non-receipt.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Annual real property assessment notice and delivery
proposedGroups.reason: These provisions describe annual notice, electronic availability, state-and-condition content, last-known-address mailing, and directed mailing addresses.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how annual real property assessment notices are prepared, mailed, made available, and directed to addresses.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Copies to users or occupiers and tax liability
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections cover requested copies to users or occupiers and preserve the assessed person tax liability.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall when a user or occupier may receive a copy of the notice and what that does not change.

proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 21(5) states the legal effect of notice errors, omissions, misdescriptions, and non-receipt.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall that notice defects or non-receipt do not create an exemption from assessment.

reason: Section 21.1 defines error for section 22 as factual-information error, not a real-and-true-value determination.

not in the determination of the real and true value

proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall the section 22 meaning of error in the real property assessment list.

reason: Section 22 requires the Director to correct assessment-list errors, alter the list, send an amended notice, and furnish the local amendment.

evidenceText: shall correct the error and alter the list
furnish the appropriate local government or other taxing authority

proposedGroups.reason: Section 22 requires the Director to correct assessment-list errors, alter the list, send an amended notice, and furnish the local amendment.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall what the Director must do after discovering an error in the real property assessment list.

reason: Section 22.1 covers omitted liable property generally and paragraph (b.1) real property reassessment despite sections 21 and 22.

reason: Section 23 combines annual assessment-list maintenance with public inspection and release rules for assessment-list information.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Public inspection and release of assessment-list information
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections state how assessment lists may be inspected, released, and made electronically available.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how real property assessment list information may be inspected, released, and made electronically available.

Section 25 contains separate review-request requirements, Director reconsideration and notice duties, effect of the decision, and limits on spillover to other assessments.

proposedGroups.reason: The opening subsections cover who may request review, the deadline, register, and information that must be included.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall how a person requests Director review of an assessment and what the request must contain.

proposedGroups.titleSuggestion: Director decision, notice, and assessment-list changes
proposedGroups.reason: These subsections state the Director decision options, required notices, effective date, and list-change timing.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall what the Director may decide on review and how that decision is communicated and implemented.

proposedGroups.reason: Subsection 25(8) limits the effect of review or appeal changes on other assessments.
proposedGroups.approximateLearningGoal: Recall that a changed assessment does not alter other assessments unless those assessments are separately changed.
